### Borea v0.5.0

Borea is the community content manager for Kitten Space Agency: find mods, install them with their dependencies into separate instances of the game, and launch through StarMap.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Coming from v0.4.x

Click "Update now" on the Home banner, or run `borea update-self`.
Your instances, mods and settings stay as they are.

On macOS, Borea is now the app `Borea.app`, and "Update now" cannot install it over an older Borea: it stops with an unpack error and changes nothing.
Download the App archive once, drag `Borea.app` into Applications and delete the old `Borea` folder. Later updates install themselves.

#### Highlights

- Borea finds KSA when you installed it with the new Ahwoo client, on Windows and on Linux.
- Borea can now be translated by everyone, in the browser, see "Translate Borea" below.
- A mod or pack whose stated `game_max` is older than your game is now Incompatible and cannot be installed, so a game update no longer installs content that its author marked as broken.
- On macOS, Borea is a real app with its own name and icon in the Dock.
- Smooth scrolling, and softer hover and dropdown animations, by @BarneyCompiler.
- The Mods tab of a pack is a table, and from there you can use a newer release of a member.
- Discover sorts by "Recently listed", shows what you installed at a glance, and filters by author.

#### Translate Borea

Borea is now on [Hosted Weblate](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/borea/), and anyone can help translate it in the browser, without git and without writing code.
Pick your language, or start a new one, and translate the texts you can. A text that is not translated yet shows in English, so a partial translation already helps.
Weblate sends the changes to Borea as a pull request, which we review, and they reach Borea with the next release.
The pirate translation already has new texts from there, thanks to @Kiwi-Shark.
More about it in the [translation guide](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/blob/main/docs/localization.md).

#### For players

##### Ahwoo client

- On Windows and Linux, Borea finds KSA when the Ahwoo client installed it, also when you never used the KSA installer.
- If you have both, the old KSA installer and the Ahwoo client, Borea offers both game folders to pick from.

##### Compatibility

- A mod or pack whose `game_max` is older than your game is Incompatible and cannot be installed, like one that needs a newer game. Content without a `game_max` stays Compatible.
- Borea no longer shows Untested for content. The chip, the warning and the confirmation are gone.
- A pack that pins a release above its `game_max` is Incompatible, and the pack page names that release and the last game version it supports.
- A dependency whose newest release is above its `game_max` falls back to an older release that fits.

##### Discover and mod pages

- Sort the Mods and Modpacks tabs by "Recently listed" to find new content first.
- A mod or pack you installed has a green check and an "Installed" chip.
- Click an author name on a row, or on a mod or pack page, to see only the content of that author. A "By <name>" chip removes the filter.
- The Versions tab of a mod page shows the downloads of each release.
- The buttons of a mod or pack page move below the title when the window is too narrow for them, so no button is cut off.

##### Instances and mod packs

- The lists of an instance line up like a table, also in a narrow window and while a mod updates.
- The Mods tab of a pack is a table. From there you can use a newer release of a member in the instance made from the pack, also when you pinned it, and go back to the pack's version.
- On Windows, changing an instance no longer fails now and then with an "access denied" message.

##### The App

- Smooth scrolling keeps its speed from notch to notch, and the wheel over a field that cannot scroll moves the page.
- On macOS, Borea opens from Applications with its own name and icon, without a Terminal window, opens `borea://` links, and updates the whole app bundle.

#### For mod authors

- The listing editor shows the dependencies of your mod.toml and helps you add bounds, and it checks the members of a modpack as the index does.
- A fork or a SpaceDock mod can prove that you own it, as the index accepts it.
- The listing editor reads and keeps `tag_prefix`, so the index takes only the releases whose tag starts with it.
- Before the pull request, the editor checks the folder in your release zip, reads your listed images again and suggests a commit address for an image on a branch, and explains a refused value in words, as the index does.

#### For stewards

- A Steward entry in the navigation rail.
- Released archives that are gone from their host on the Watcher tab, and release changes and dependency removals on the author's behalf.
- Comment on, close and reopen a report from the Reports tab.

#### Command line

- The CLI says incompatible instead of untested. `pack search` and `pack show` rate a pack by its pinned releases too, and `pack install` and `pack update` name the bound that blocks.

#### Good to know

- This version is tested with KSA 2026.10.19.5638.
- Borea ships with the .NET runtime 10.0.13, as v0.4.1 does.
- Borea is a community project by the KSA Modding team. It is not made by RocketWerkz.
